name: Add logger instrumentation to 4 pipeline stages
description: Inject logger calls across fetchRecord, transformRecord, validateRecord, and persistRecord in src/pipeline.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Update the PipelineRunner in src/pipeline.ts to call logger methods at each stage of execution: 1) fetchRecord: logger.info(`[pipeline] fetching record ${id}`), 2) transformRecord: logger.info(`[pipeline] transforming record ${record.id}`), 3) validateRecord: logger.info(`[pipeline] validating record ${record.id}`) or logger.warn(`[pipeline] invalid record ${record.id}`) if empty, 4) persistRecord: logger.info(`[pipeline] persisting record ${record.id}`). Ensure all tests in test/pipeline.test.ts pass.

acceptance_criteria: fetchRecord logs info message with id
transformRecord logs info message with record.id
validateRecord logs info or warn appropriately
persistRecord logs info message with record.id
